_meta.notes: Living results artifact. Updated as cells complete. The presentation.md narrative wraps story/insights around these numbers.

Qwen/Qwen3-32B (max_tokens=1024 BROKEN).note: TRUNCATED — thinking mode + 1024 cap. NOT a fair number.

Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B.note: in flight; subagent run, vllm 0.20.2 + transformers 5.8.0 + FLASH_ATTN backend

linking.description: LLM linker pass selects relevant tables/columns from a compact schema; downstream SQL gen uses filtered DDL. Lexical pass + ensure_keys closure on FKs.
bug_fixes: FK with NULL to_column from PRAGMA — handle gracefully (commit 6c92e33)

restrict_schema → _column_def emitted column names without backticks; multi-word BIRD names became invalid DDL → exec_errors. Backtick-quote always (commit fe54b5e). Cost ~1.4pp on Qwen3-Coder-MoE, ~1.4pp on Qwen2.5-Coder.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: biggest regression in matrix; exec_error 18 -> 81. Most confident base, most disrupted by filtered DDL.

voting.description: n=8 candidates per question at T=0.6. Execute each, group by canonical result-set hash (SHA-1 of sorted-repr rows), return the SQL whose result has the most votes among executable candidates.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (T=1.0).note: DIAGNOSTIC: bumped to T=1.0 to test MoE-expert-diversity hypothesis. RESULT: WORSE than T=0.6 (+0.13 vs +0.45). Voting on this base is bounded by model capability, not sampling diversity. R1 hypothesis falsified.

Qwen3-32B (thinking, v2).note: in flight — v2 re-run after the v1 hit 1h Modal timeout; 2h cap now

correction.description: First pass greedy. For exec_error cases, retry with the SQLite error message in the prompt at T=0.2. Cap at 1 retry.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: correction floor — Qwen3.6 has so few exec_errors (~18-21) that rescuing them just hits baseline; no semantic-wrong gains possible from this strategy

cot.description: Two-stage. Stage 1: NL plan at T=0.3 (max_tokens=384). Stage 2: SQL conditioned on the plan at T=0.0 (max_tokens=1024 default; 8192 for thinking).
cot.regression_root_cause: commitment bias — NL plan locks model into wrong column / value choices that free-form SQL would have re-thought. e.g., NCESDist instead of NCESSchool; 'Directly Funded' instead of 'Directly funded'; County instead of City.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: Regressed less than predicted (-1.5 to -2.5pp); thinking + plan stage doubly redundant on a thinking model.

fewshot.description: k=4 examples retrieved from BIRD train via Jaccard on tokenized question text. Same-db_id preferred; cross-db fallback. BIRD train and dev have disjoint db_ids by design — shots are stylistic / pattern-only, never schema-cheating.
fewshot.regression_root_cause_on_strong_coder: anchor bias — shots' patterns (e.g., * 100 ratios, AVG aggregations, JOIN style) get copied into the current question even when inappropriate.

Qwen3-32B (thinking).note: biggest single-strategy lift on Qwen3-32B; non-coder thinking model has SQL-pattern gap that shots fill

Qwen3.6-27B.note: PREDICTION WRONG. Predicted +1-2.5pp based on Q3-32B-thinking +3.07pp pattern; actual is -0.39pp. Fewshot's value diminishes faster than expected as base strength grows.

stacked_voting_correction.description: Composed strategy: greedy correction first; only escalate to voting+correction if greedy errored OR returned degenerate result. Inside voting: greedy is candidate-0 (R2: strict-override only), rescued candidates can't outvote originally-valid ones (R3).

Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct.note: STACKING GAIN: +0.52pp over either voting alone OR correction alone (+0.78). Older-gen base has more diversity-at-T=0.7 → voting finds 13 legitimate corrections greedy missed.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct.note: Worked as engineered; 6.6% escalation; vote rarely overrides greedy. Below correction-alone (+0.91pp). Voting itself has near-zero marginal value on this confident base.

key_insights: Generation gap dominates at 32B-class: Qwen3 → Qwen2.5 closes ~3.3pp on the same coder-instruct base.
For SQL, coder post-training > thinking-mode + general post-training. Qwen3-Coder-MoE (no thinking) beats Qwen3-32B-thinking-general by ~9pp.
Stronger / newer models concentrate failures away from exec_error: 150 → 38 → 25 → 23.
CoT regresses on every coder base (-1.6 to -2.4pp) due to commitment bias.
Repair strategies (correction, voting) are universally positive but small (+0.4 to +0.9pp). Bounded by exec_error count.
Modify-the-prompt strategies (linking, fewshot) are base-dependent: help weaker / non-coder bases, hurt strong coder bases.
Schema linking with 97.8% recall STILL regressed on Qwen3-Coder-MoE (-1.37pp) because the filtered DDL tilts the model toward worse column choices even when all gold columns are kept.
On strong coder bases, the way to climb further is training (RL on execution rewards) or a better base, not more prompt scaffolding.
